necromancer__root.title: Raise Dead
necromancer__root.description: Unlocks Raise Dead (Level 3) (50 mana, 142.5 s cooldown) on the ability wheel
necromancer__root.extra_description: Cast to summon undead minions from the earth beneath you. The higher the power, the better equipment they will have. The first skill of the Necromancer base.

necromancer__piercing_blood.title: Piercing Blood
necromancer__piercing_blood.description: Unlocks Piercing Blood (18 mana, 2 s cooldown) on the ability wheel: hold to fire a beam of compressed blood

necromancer__hasty_casting.title: Hasty Casting
necromancer__hasty_casting.description: Teaches Hasty Casting, an Epic Fight Mobility skill: Spells take half as long to cast, and much faster movement while casting. Equip it in the Combat Skills box of the abilities screen

necromancer__breathe_again.title: Second Wind
necromancer__breathe_again.description: Teaches Second Wind, an Epic Fight Passive skill: A fatal hit is cancelled by spending all your mana. Equip it in the Combat Skills box of the abilities screen

necromancer__renewal_2.title: Renewal 2
necromancer__renewal_2.extra_description: Core bonus (every archetype has this spoke).

necromancer__ray_of_siphoning.title: Ray of Siphoning
necromancer__ray_of_siphoning.description: Unlocks Ray of Siphoning (Level 3) (7 mana, 21.38 s cooldown) on the ability wheel
necromancer__ray_of_siphoning.extra_description: Hold to cast a ray of necrotic energy that siphons health from creatures it hits, damaging them and healing you for 100% of damage done.

necromancer__blood_rush.extra_description: Applies Blood Dash to yourself, granting Blood Spell Power bonus and life steal on damage dealt.

necromancer__sacrifice.title: Sacrifice
necromancer__sacrifice.description: Unlocks Sacrifice (Level 3) (25 mana, 2.85 s cooldown) on the ability wheel
necromancer__sacrifice.extra_description: Target one of your magic summons to cause them to explode, killing them instantly, and dealing large damage in the area around them. The summon's remaining health boosts the damage dealt and radius of explosion.

necromancer__vigor_siphon.title: Vigor Siphon
necromancer__vigor_siphon.description: Unlocks Vigor Siphon (Level 2) (79 mana, 285 s cooldown) on the ability wheel
necromancer__vigor_siphon.extra_description: Cast to connect with your nearest summon. Damage dealt by the summon heals you, and your damage heals the summon in return. If you die while tethered, the linked summon is sacrificed to restore you with 8hp
